EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/2014/HW/86.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the Land to be acquired: The allotments of land described below, depicted as lots 1,2,3,4,5 & 6 in Preliminary Plan No. Ma/1650, prepared by Surveyor General, situated at Thotagamuwa, Aluvihare villages (Ward No. 1 within the Municipal Council limit of Matale) Gampahasiya Pattuwa minor Division of Matale Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province.

Lot No. 1 — Thotagamuwa Estate; Claimant: E. M. M. Lal Ekanayake; Extent: 0.431 Hectare. North: Thotagamuwa Estate claimed by E. M. M. Lal Ekanayake and Road (R.D.A); East: Road (R.D.A); South: Lot No. 3 in P.P.Ma. 936 and Lot No. 2 in same plan and Thotagamuwa paddy land alias pansale Kumbura claimed by Ven. Kosgolle Somananda Thera; West: Thota-gamuwa estate claimed by E. M. M. Lal Ekanayake.

Lot No. 2 — Thotagamuwa Estate alias Pansale Kumbura; Claimant: Ven. Kosgolle Somananda Thera; Extent: 0.0104 Hectare. North: Thotagamuwa Estate claimed by E. M. M. Lal Ekanayake and Lot No. 1; East: 3 in P.P.Ma. 936; South: Lot No. 3 in P.P.Ma. 936 and Thotagamuwa paddy land alias pansale Kumbura claimed by Ven. Kosgolle Somananda Thera; West: Thotagamuwa paddy land alias Pansale Kumbura claimed by Ven. Kosgolle Somananda Thera.

Lot No. 3 — Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta; Claimant: M. R. Rakamma; Extent: 0.0018 Hectare. North: Trincomalee Street & Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta claimed by M. R. Rakamma; East: Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta claimed by M. R. Rakamma; South: Canal; West: Canal and Trincomalee Street.

Lot No. 4 — Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta; Claimant: M. C. Jayasinghe; Extent: 0.0216 Hectare. North: Trincomalee Street and Canal; East: Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta claimed by M. C. Jayasinghe; South: Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta claimed by C. M. K. Chandrarathna and Lot No. 5; West: Trincomalee Street.

Lot No. 5 — Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta; Claimant: C. M. K. Chandrarathna; Extent: 0.0215 Hectare. North: Lot No. 4 and Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta claimed by M. C. Lot No. 6 — Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta; Claimant: C. M. K. Chandrarathna; Extent: 0.0021 Hectare. North: Lot No. 5 and Mutthettuyayewatta and Galedandeyayewatta claimed by C. M. K. G. Senavirathna Bandara; West: Trincomalee Street.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 11th day of January, 2016 at the Matale Divisional Secretariat.

And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 04th day of January 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. P. K. L. P. MADHUWANTHI, Divisional Secretary, Matale.
Divisional Secretariat, Matale, 30th October, 2015. 11-504
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: 3/2/1/138.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired:
Lot No. 1 to 6 allotments below name land in total extent of about 0.0932, shown in Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 3977 and dated 14.10.2015, prepared by the Senior

Superintendent of Surveys, Gampaha District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Katugasthara in the Grama Niladari Division of No. 135/1 Asgiriwalpola-South and Minor Division of Dasiyapattuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Minuwangoda, in the District of Gampaha in Western Province.
01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Palamalaga Othukumbura; Land use: Garden; Claimant: M. D. C. Nelson, No. 23/1, Katugasthara, Gampaha; Extent: 0.0143 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Palamalaga Othukumbura; Land use: Garden; Claimant: K. A. F. E. Perera, No. 23, Katugasthara, Gampaha; Extent: 0.0188 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Palamalaga Othukumbura; Land use: Garden; Claimant: Lucas Fernando, No. 23/2, Katugasthara, Gampaha; Extent: 0.0257 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Cannot be found; Land use: Garden; Claimant: Cannot be found; Extent: 0.0165 Hectare.
05. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Cannot be found; Land use: Garden; Claimant: K. T. R. Karunanayake, No. 202, Thammita, Botuwadeniya, Makevita; Extent: 0.0123 Hectare.

06. Lot No. 6 Name of the Land: Assmt. No. 775/1/1, Aswennawatta Road; Land use: Garden, contains a part of permanent building; Claimant: Anil Perera, No. 23/3, Katugasthara, Gampaha; Extent: 0.0056 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Minuwangoda on the 02nd December, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing [in duplicate] on or before the 23rd November, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. A. S. LAKSRINI GUNATILAKA, Divisional Secretary, Minuwangoda.
Divisional Secretariat, Minuwangoda. 02nd November, 2015. 11-505
